about: Standing work queues for the other AIs (owner 2026-10-08: 'share workload with Grok; when it completes a task give it another; there should always be something for all other agents to work on'). Claude keeps every active queue at 3 or more open tasks and refreshes it at every intake. Each AI works top to bottom: when one task is done it writes DONE and the date under it in its Drive queue doc (or says so in chat) and starts the next one without waiting. Rendered by tools/agents/render_queues.py into docs/agents/QUEUE_{agent}.md, the agent's Drive doc and the fix list.
